title: Truncate
description: Shortens text to a maximum length with a suffix, optionally on a word boundary.

ts: truncate("The quick brown fox", 12, { wordBoundary: true }); // "The quick…"
hs: let longString = "Haskell is a powerful functional programming language."
print $ truncateString 20 longString -- Output: "Haskell is a powe..."
print $ truncateString 54 longString -- Output: "Haskell is a powerful functional programming language."
rb: long_string = "Ruby is a dynamic, open source programming language."
puts truncate_string(20, long_string) # Output: "Ruby is a dynamic..."
puts truncate_string(54, long_string) # Output: "Ruby is a dynamic, open source programming language."
py: truncate('This is a long string', 10) # Returns: 'This is a ...'
truncate('This is a long string', 10, False) # Returns: 'This is a '
